existingPlaybackImplementations.shape: VideoPlayerController serving BOTH audio and video. For audio: play/pause plus the hardcoded literal 'Voice note'. NO progress, NO timeline, NO duration, NO error state.
A StatelessWidget. NO playback at all — it rendered a row and handed the file to the browser.
VideoPlayerController for VIDEO inside the fullscreen viewer. Legitimately different responsibility; left untouched.

authorityEstablishedBeforeChanging.verdict: The product held two competing answers to 'how does a voice message play', and one of them was 'it does not'. That is accidental duplication, not destination policy: nothing in Correspondence's charter makes audio behave differently, and its surface simply never received playback.
authorityEstablishedBeforeChanging.strongestCandidate: Neither. Conversation's was closer but lacked the entire half F014 names, so the canonical capability was built from the two and consumed by both.

productDefectsRemoved: No progress or timeline anywhere — the literal subject of F014.
No duration shown, although Media.duration is authoritative.
The label 'Voice note' was hardcoded for ALL audio, so an uploaded MP3 was announced as a recording it was not.
Correspondence had no inline playback at all.
A failed load was silent — a broken voice note looked identical to one that had not started.

voiceIsNotMerelyAudio.groundedIn: Media.source == RECORDING, stamped by the composer at capture (conversation_screen sets source RECORDING for AUDIO kind).
voiceIsNotMerelyAudio.notFoldedIntoTheMimeResolver: attachmentKindFrom answers a MIME-shaped question; voice-vs-audio is SOURCE-shaped. Collapsing them would make an uploaded audio/m4a indistinguishable from a recording again — the exact false claim being removed.
voiceIsNotMerelyAudio.presentationDiffers: A recording is announced as 'Voice message'; an uploaded file keeps its own filename.
voiceIsNotMerelyAudio.playbackDoesNotDiffer: Nothing in the product makes their playback semantics differ, so they were not split for the sake of splitting.

nothingInvented: Duration comes from Media.duration (MILLISECONDS, F133) and, once loaded, from the media element itself.

When neither knows, position is shown WITHOUT a total rather than against a fabricated one. A zero or negative duration is treated as unknown, because a confident '0:00' claims the recording is empty.
NO waveform is drawn. The product computes no amplitude data and a decorative one would assert a shape the bytes never had.
No transcription, recording quality or inferred characteristic is displayed.
Seeking is offered ONLY once a real duration is known, because seeking against an unknown total cannot be honoured. No dead controls.
backendChange: conversations.service.ts — the message media projection now also selects source and duration, emitted as source and durationMs. Additive; no schema change, no migration, no production data.

consolidation.legitimateDestinationDifferences: Correspondence renders the player at a wider width to match its message column. That is composition, not competing semantics.

boundariesObserved: CH-11 content truth consumed, never re-decided — source and duration are read, never recomputed.
